name: Safwan Digital Catalog Feed for OpenAI Ads
author: Safwan Digital

sections.description:
Safwan Digital Catalog Feed for OpenAI Ads creates a stable hosted CSV product feed from your WooCommerce catalog. It is designed for stores that want an easy way to keep catalog data refreshed while retaining manual control.

The plugin is independently developed by Safwan Digital. It is not an official OpenAI or WooCommerce product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or WooCommerce.

Main features

  • Automatic feed regeneration when WooCommerce product data changes.
  • Debounced change queue to reduce repeated regeneration during bulk edits.
  • Manual “Sync / Update Feed Now” action.
  • Scheduled fallback refresh every hour, 6 hours, 12 hours, or daily.
  • Stable hosted CSV URL.
  • Variable product and variation support.
  • WooCommerce stock and sale-price support.
  • Brand taxonomy mapping and default brand fallback.
  • GTIN and MPN detection from common WooCommerce product meta keys.
  • OpenAI eligibility fields and ads metadata fields.
  • Local feed validation and diagnostics.
  • Feed download for inspection.
  • Local activity logs.
  • Guided setup and contextual help inside WooCommerce admin.
  • HPOS compatibility declaration.
  • No telemetry or analytics collection.
  • Original product images are referenced by URL only. The plugin does not modify product images.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or transmit customer records, personal data, analytics, telemetry, or administrator activity to Safwan Digital.

The generated product feed is intentionally public because a hosted feed must be reachable by the feed consumer. The feed contains product catalog information such as title, description, product URL, image URL, price, availability, brand, seller name, category, product identifier, and optional catalog metadata. It does not export WooCommerce customer or order data.

Important

Feed generation inside WordPress can happen immediately, but external feed ingestion is asynchronous. Updating the local hosted feed does not guarantee an instant update in OpenAI Ads Manager.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload this plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress.org Plugin Directory when available.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Safwan Digital Catalog Feed.
  5. Review Settings and confirm seller name, brand handling, product ID strategy, variation behavior, and automatic sync.
  6. Open Dashboard and click “Sync / Update Feed Now”.
  7. Copy the hosted feed URL.
  8. Add the hosted URL to the product-feed setup in OpenAI Ads Manager.
  9. Review Diagnostics after major catalog imports or bulk edits.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin edit product images?

No. It reads the existing WooCommerce product image URL and writes that URL to the feed. It does not redraw, resize, replace, or modify the product photo.

Does automatic sync mean OpenAI Ads updates instantly?

No. The plugin can regenerate the hosted feed quickly after a WooCommerce change, but OpenAI controls feed ingestion and processing timing.

Does the plugin collect customer data?

No. The product feed is built from catalog/product data only. The plugin does not export customers or orders.

Where is the plugin located in WordPress admin?

WooCommerce > Safwan Digital Catalog Feed.

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

By default, the plugin removes its settings, local logs, scheduled events, and generated feed files. You can disable that behavior in Settings before uninstalling.
